objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object in the system that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle stages. Represents policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, and other controlled content.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The document type abbreviation included in the document name (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: A cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type, assigned automatically upon creation.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The current version number of the document, updated upon revision.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document is considered valid, set upon release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The defined period for which the document remains valid before a validity check is required (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data associated with this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications referenced or associated with the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational entities for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Scopes or areas where the document applies.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope designation of the document, which can be printed via TAG technology.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The person registered as the primary author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons with change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment defining who has read access to the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups or persons informed by email notification upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups or persons required to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specifies in which clients of a multi-client system the document is visible.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A classification category for documents that defines the level, abbreviation, templates, validity period, and archive duration applicable to documents of that type.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the document type (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The short code used in document naming for this type.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the document type in the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: The default period of extended validity for documents of this type.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: The default archive duration for documents of this type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the document template.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: The source format of the template (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document object attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the main document's release process.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the attachment, following the main document's release statuses.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document supplement that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle; released directly via property switches.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name or title of the additional information object.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest changes to an existing released document, managed without affecting the document's content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The content describing the proposed change.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a released document that no longer has validity, triggering an approval workflow.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, which can only be created by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users in the system used to assign read or change authorizations, distribution lists, and role-based access to documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the user group (e.g., Reader - Document Management, Archive).

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who can be assigned roles and participate in document workflows.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the user.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: The license role assigned to the user (e.g., READER, AUTHOR).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A recorded signature by a workflow participant that documents their completion of a workflow step, stored per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the signature was applied.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The workflow step associated with the signature (e.g., Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for notification upon release, either by email or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation record by a user that they have read and acknowledged a released document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

attributes.name: confirmed_by
attributes.description: The user who confirmed the acknowledgement.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: The date when the acknowledgement was confirmed.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity in the system to which documents can be linked for structured filing and management.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the organizational unit.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process managed in the system to which documents can be linked for process-specific filing.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the business process.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk entity in the system that can be linked to documents for risk-related document management.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the risk.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application registered as master data in the system that can be referenced by documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the IT application.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational client in a multi-client system, determining document visibility and local document management.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the client.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type selected during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template selected during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or changed via property editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF after saving.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step (Creator) with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and formal correctness and completes the review step with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the review was positive or a rejection.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document and completes the release step with an electronic signature, making the document released and published.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the release was approved or rejected.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which the rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created automatically when content, attributes, or attachments are changed.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The reason the new version was created (e.g., content change, attachment change, change proposal scheduled).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new attachment object is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: A previously archived attachment is reactivated as part of a document reactivation process.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is created and added to a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is released and published directly via property switches.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted directly due to its lack of criticality.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created by an author for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: An author documents the completion of an assigned change proposal.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser (or author/reviewer/releaser) confirms that the document remains valid, updating the Valid Until date and deleting the extension request.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a released document.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: The override request is approved through the workflow, setting the document status to Out of Force and revoking authorizations.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms the reactivation, creating a new version of the document and restoring authorizations and distribution lists.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: An email notification is sent to users or user groups as part of distribution by email upon document release.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users assigned to the distribution for acknowledgement are automatically requested by email to confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user actively confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow-supported task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A released document's content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: A reviewer checks the translated document version for correctness.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the translation review was positive or a rejection.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A releaser approves the translated document version, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the translation release was approved or rejected.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: A document is physically deleted from the system after the archive duration has expired.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: The type of authorization assigned (read or change).

o2o.description: Each document belongs to a specific document type that determines its level, abbreviation, validity period, and archive duration.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can have one or more controlled attachments that are subject to the document's release process.
A document can have one or more additional information objects that are not subject to the release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within that document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity needs to be checked.
A request for override is created for a specific document to invalidate and archive it.
A request for reactivation references the specific archived document to be reactivated.
Each document has a distribution list defining user groups and persons to be notified upon release.
Documents can be linked to organizational units for structured filing.
Documents can be linked to business processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to risks for risk-related document management.
Documents can reference IT applications maintained as master data.
Documents can reference other documents through the references attribute.
In a multi-client system, a document's visibility is specified per client.
A distribution list contains user groups assigned for notification.
A distribution list can contain individual persons assigned for notification.
Users are assigned to user groups for authorization and role management.
Electronic signatures are documented per released version of a document.
Acknowledgements are recorded per released document version for users on the distribution list.
